answer: A creation-fee market stops batch-forged identities. Each new identity crosses a bridge gate; the fee starts at 20 credits and rises 2 per registration this epoch. An ivory fee board posts the live price: the k-th identity pays 20+2(k-1). Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,019,000 credits, no bulk discount. The haven ledger publishes every fee, so an auditor can spot a rented-key ring. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps every earning.
